Diese App ist Betrug.. Ich habe die Bestellung nie erhalten, obwohl sie als zugestellt markiert wurde, das Restaurant geht nicht ans Telefon, und der Kundenservice hält mich nur hin. Sie haben mein Geld gestohlen und mein Essen nicht geliefert.
My voucher is not working. I spent over 100 euros last order and now knew vouchers and the old one doesn’t work :(
App confirms delivery but order was never received.. Used this app twice. Never received my orders. Waist of time and money.
Hmmm…. Is it me or has the PayPal option for payment have been removed?🤔😒
Terrible. Terrible experience. Poor consumer support. Keep waiting and the only support i get a robot can only answer 2 questions with no copy and paste answer. Never again.

The worst food delivery app. Multiple occasions food says delivered but not there, and guess what, no way to contact anyone. Absolutely never download this disgusting scam of an app if I could give 0 stars I would I hope one day they go out of business so nobody has to interact with this abysmal failure of a company.

If you get your food is kind of up to chance. I ordered food waited for an hour they said they were on their way and gave it away to someone else when I tried to file for a refund they said there was nothing they could do so I wouldn’t recommend

Great concept, but poor issue resolution. I really appreciate having a delivery service like Lieferando, it’s convenient and easy to use, especially on busy days. However, I’ve had multiple experiences where items were missing or orders were incorrect.

The biggest issue is that there’s no clear or effective way to resolve these problems. Once the delivery is completed and the driver has left, it becomes very difficult to file a claim or follow up. There should be a straightforward option within the app to report missing or incorrect items and request a refund or reimbursement.

Because of this, I’m giving 2 stars. The service has a lot of potential, but the lack of reliable customer support and resolution options is frustrating. I hope they improve this, as it would make a big difference in the overall experience

Deniz. Şimdiye kadar yediğim en güzel yemekti artık bundan sonra buradayım ve herkese de tavsiye ediyorum gerçekten yemekleri çok güzel sıcak ve çok da hızlı geliyor ve paket sistemine bayıldım harika bir paket sistemi

Nonexistent customer service. The restaurant I ordered from hadn’t even acknowledged the order one hour after I ordered. It was clearly not responding, but Lieferando’s customer service “AI” just repeated that cancellation is not possible and there’s nothing they can do. With this kind of garbage service, this company is not going to survive. Absolute BS.
Scam. Scam. If I could leave negative stars I would. No customer support. Not even a trained bot.
No restaurant tracking or customer service. Using AI support is fine as long as a human can intervene.

App is Stealing people money. I have orderd via this app in Vienna, But money was deducted from my card 33 Euro and products were never delivered, order # J3V4MY, tried to reach to customer service but AI never connect you to people and I raised a request but never responded
Your AI contact is useless. The RyanAir of delivery services.
Food didn’t come. Still waiting for a refund

Fraudulent. Honestly at this point, Lieferando is a scam and I have reported the company to German consumer protection authorities (Verbraucherzentrale) and encourage others with terrible experiences to do the same. There is no actual customer service of any kind, when you get an email from support they will either do nothing, repeat the misinformation that led you to contact support in the first place and incorrectly announce (in their very first email, with zero input from you) that your issue has been resolved. Or they just cancel your order, again without asking you, then keep a chunk of the fees. The app claims that orders are delivered literally over an hour before they actually are. All of the estimated wait times should be at least doubled. You don’t receive a full refund because a chunk of the fees are not returned to you. At this point I’m shocked that they are still operating but it won’t be long.

The worst app. If anything goes wrong with your order their chat service is absolutely trash. I never can get help. It just repeats the same thing over and over again. Everytime I order something goes wrong with the delivery as well. Never ordering off this app again.
Easy to use. Moved to Germany recently and this app is a blessing. Convenient and easy use. The English translation makes it easy to order delivery.
Bad. Not a very functional app, never received my order. Hard to communicate.

2 counts of no refunds in 1 week. Genuinely zero support exists for this platform. No one cares if your order arrived or someone else took it. Have been using this service for a long time but only faced problems with two orders not being delivered. Reached out and found out there is no support to answer the emails and no refunds either.

WOULD RATE 0 STARTS if I could

Customer service inexistent. This app doesn’t check the restaurants on the ratings allowing bad restaurants to take the money and don’t let you cancel the order if it passed the close of business, i have a ticket open and until the restaurant close it i cannot process the refund! And there is NO CUSTOMER SERVICE TO ASSIST! It’s a bott to manage the chat!

Unusable - not payment method available. I've been using this app no problem with my Apple Pay but suddenly today I am getting an error message when I go to check out - "sorry this payment method is not available, please try another". However none of the other payment methods work either.
Terrible scam. Ordered food never received it no notifications no updates no support

Horrendous. Their delivery person did not deliver what I ordered. After contacting the company and telling them that every front desk employee stated the delivery did not arrived, they refused to refund the order. Once you give them your credit card information and pay, don’t expect them to show up. I would at minimum advise no American to trust them.

They allow stores to steal money.. I had 3 different restaurants fail to deliver food. They said they needed more money or will not deliver. I tried to get a refund or credit. Lieferando said they could or give me a refund or credit, nor did they make the restaurant deliver the food. I lost money and food. Lieferando allows restaurants to scam you. DO NOT USE!!!!

Worst Delivery Service Ever. I ordered from a restaurant in Berlin. It was very delayed not great but it happens. The food was ready but Lieferando never dispatched a courier. 

I tried to reach out to support but it's just an ai bot with the same 3 responses. I was in limbo for 90 minutes until the system finally cancelled. 

I will never use this again. Stay away.
Fees. They're now charging a service fee. Not worth the money.
Sehr gut und wichtig. Alles geklappt

Really bad bug with timezone. If you try to remotely schedule food delivery for your family who may be in a different time zone, Lieferando totally messes it up. They don’t use the time where the food is located but use YOUR local time. Worse yet, there’s no indication whatsoever. My family is starving because of this.

Review. Great service and easy to use! The only recommendation I have is for some restaurants like McDonald’s, you can’t place the same order that’s in your order history. You have to re-add things each time. The old Lieferando used to allow you to reorder the same order from your history but not since Lieferando got an update.

Fake reviews of restaurants. I noticed that many restaurants have considerably higher rate in Lieferando than in Google! 
I don’t think this is by accident! The restaurants probably faked stars and reviews! 
Lieferando is responsible for such incident!
Great. Great way to get food delivered as a busy family
Love 🍎 Pay. Thank you for adding Apple Pay! Maybe AMEX next?

Please stop abusing push notifications for spam. I’ve been a customer since the inception. I’ve stuck with you guys through ups, downs and acquisitions. All I’m asking is for you to give me the option to disable promotional notifications. I find it profoundly annoying, even disrespectful. I order when I’m hungry, not because I get spammy promotional push notifications. I keep having to disable notifications and reenable them when I do order so I know when my food is coming. 

Seriously, with this kind of policy, you are invading sacred space. In a lazy way. Put in the work, and let users fine-tune options about what they exactly want to get notifications about at least. I personally might even use that, to get promotions about two restaurants. But the way it is now, it’s pushy, lazy, spammy and desperate.

Best Pizza!. We lived in Mackenbach 2008-2013 and fell in love with Pizza Attack! When we found out we were moving back to Germany (June 2024), we were so thrilled! We knew we’d order pizza asap. Our kids love the humongous pizza. We’ve ordered Pizza from there several times already and I’m so happy to say the pizza still tastes great! I’m also very pleased that Ramstein has a Pizza Attack now. If you move to the Kaiserslautern area (KMC), buy a pizza from Pizza Attack. You won’t regret it!
Bad. My order is super late and there is no customer service to contact

DO NOT USE. The app will not tell you when something is delivered. It will sit on the being delivered stage. There is absolutely ZERO customer service or information given. Very clunky app and honestly not worth the hassle.

Update: developer responded to my comment here, but not the multiple requests placed on the app. And the response in here was to blame the restaurant. It’s seems the terrible customer service is a natural talent of this company lol.

your user interface..... .... had become very complicated.
there's absolutely no ease of user anymore
please simplify options again
thanks
So far so good. Food showed up! Groceries showed up! Can’t ask for much more than that.
Great for visiting from out of town. This app saved me when I was visiting from another country and didn’t speak the language or know my way around.

Terrible delivery system. I’ve done food delivery in multiple countries around the world and this has been the worst one so far. First night I waited an hour for my delivery then it was canceled. Second night they never updated her my order was out for delivery, so I was unaware when they arrived. There is no way for them to message within the app which is crazy. Only via phone and my phone is an international number so I could not be reached in time. I was still charged. I would likely be using this most nights over the month. Unless they make it right, I am completely done with this service.

New app is garbage. Unintuitive and worse functionality. 
Where is my „order again“ button? 
Fix the app.

Food will arrive. Please add customization to the orders, restaurants IGNORE the notes on the bottom of the ticket. 

Allow copy of in app text (might be a iPhone issue.)
Bugs. It has bugs.

2. I can’t see my points
3. More than half of your home page is now dominated by a map of all restaurants. This is not helpful and serves no purpose. Most important is the list of the restaurants that is now just a quarter of the page on the left.

This is just after one day of using your new app. There might be more problems, deficits that appear.
Really bad. Worst delivery UI I’ve ever seen. Absolutely no excuse as a business to have that so bad.

Lieferando is no help with the wrong order. Lieferando adds on service charges to handle your order, but when something is delivered incorrectly they’re no help and tell you to contact the restaurant directly. Save the time and skip the middleman, don’t let Lieferando cover for bad restaurants.
Sehr gut. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ pizza war lecker
Lieferando. Love this app. My only request would be an option to translate the menus into different languages.
Transaction Charge. Be careful, they added a transaction charge quietly for payments with Apple Pay.

RUN AWAY. The WORST customer service out there. I had an order get confirmed as delivered and received… funny thing is, I never got my order! I even requested to be met at the front of my building… I was never called nor contacted. 

I reached out to the company via email and chat in the app and they told me that they saw the order as delivered (the email response) and that I needed to contact the restaurant myself to have them approve a refund (the chat). I was on a vacation. I don’t know the restaurant. I do not want this hassle. 

I’m disgusted with this response. For all I know, the driver took the food and ran. Deleting the app and encouraging you to use ANYTHING else for your food delivery needs.
Don’t use. Order never arrived, do NOT use this service. It’s a scam.
Luigi’s is super. It’s always great good and fast delivery. I’m glad they’re here!

Incredibly terrible app, no delivery notification and they take no responsibility. Ordered through them and was giving me a countdown, said 12 minutes so I headed downstairs as it was to my hotel and I said I would meet them outside to make it easier. Then app just said ‘arriving soon’ and I waited for over 30 minutes with no updates. Over an hour later it still says it’s arriving soon still. 2 hours after I order (delivery was 15-40 min estimate) I get a message asking if I enjoyed the food. I contact customer service and they say it was delivered an hour ago and they couldn’t find me so left at hotel reception. I went there and they said it came maybe 30 minutes ago, and I was sent no notification or called as the app and restaurant both had my number. Customer services tells me ‘they did their job’ and to contact the restaurant, I said I paid them and not the restaurant, he says ‘no, you paid then through us’, this is a lie as it is not the restaurant name on my credit card bill. Then he ended the chat and wouldn’t answer my other questions. Absolutely awful.

Not Usable for Hearing Impaired. No one reads my notes that show I can't hear.

Niemand liest meine Notizen, aus denen hervorgeht, dass ich nicht hören kann.
Mr Rizaak. Very nice place I like it 😋

Unreliable app, no way to escalate issues. EDIT: Lieferando has stolen €36 from me. I ordered a burger and they took the money from my account, but never confirmed the order. Since they provide NO way to escalate issues, this bug is simple theft. I will never use this service again, and have reported them to Apple for fraud.

 

Good selection of food, but delivery is often HOURS late, and Lieferando does not make it possible to do anything about it.

Never received food. Yikes, first order i place and i never received the food. Traveling in Germany for work and i downloaded and ordered. My cc statement has the charge. I sent a message to help center stating i didnt receive my food. Whats weird is after sending the message my order vanished from the app. A real coincidence huh? Take my money, i wait an hour after expected delivery time, i complain and the record of my order vanishes from app. Luckily, i took a screenshot earlier.
Horrible service. It is slow, expensive and there is minimum amount of order to be made. If your delivery is late or lost there is no way to make a complaint
Easy and very quick even in the snow!. Food all came correctly and was delivered quick and easy, even in a snow storm!

Horrible Service. Food as not delivered for 2 hours and when I reached the customer service, they just said can’t do anything and ended the chat.

Fast delivery. Food is good 4 stars and the delivery was fast and on time. One little thing though my husband doesn’t eat pig so I would like if the restaurant would specify in each dish if the meat was either beef or schwine or turkey or what kind of meat?? But that’s not the apps fault.
The worst delivery company!!!!. They can’t deliver a simple order from McDonalds even in 3 hours! Every 10 minutes adding another 50 minutes “wait time”!!! Never again!!!
Absolutely garbage app. Terrible service, cancels orders with no push notifications or emails or anything… happened a dozen times easily. Will never use again - go with Foodora.

Ewige Lieferzeiten (2 STD) ohne Stornomöglichkeit. Essen am Abend bestellt,, Restaurant ist bereit, aber keine Lieferando Fahrer frei. Will man auf Essen, dass man am Abend bestellt, bis 22:30 Uhr warten? Keine Möglichkeiten mit dem Kundendienst zu sprechen oder zu stornieren. Total unakzeptabel!!!! Nice. Nice app, but the ratings of the restaurants don’t always match reality. YMMV
The app needs serious development. It lacks pictures of most items. Groceries are likited to snacks and drinks. They need to add fruits, vegetables and medicines too.

DO NOT USE THIS APP they will steal your money. MULTIPLE times we have tried ordering using this app, and every time our food has NEVER ARRIVED and was never even made, yet they still charged us. They suggest we call the restaurant, which we do, and they don’t answer. Then they call the restaurant for us, they still don’t answer. Then they say they will not refund us… for FOOD NEVER DELIVERED! We never even received a text or notification the food was on the way. Sometimes even 8 hours later the app would say “Your order will arrive shortly”. At this point they owe us at least 70€. Horrible horrible app and company, DO NOT USE.
English. No true English translation and the delivery times are far from accurate waiting two hrs passed time

Fix the map. You have got to finally fix the tracking map. Zooming almost always zooms the window instead of the actual map. 

Also, your tripping feature is a scam for the drivers.

Schrecklich und unfair. Wir haben über diese App bestellt und das Essen ist nie angekommen. Das Restaurant sagte uns, wir sollten die App wegen des Problems kontaktieren und weigerte sich zu helfen. Wir haben die App kontaktiert und nie etwas gehört. Es ist schrecklich und sie haben im Grunde unsere 28 Euro gestohlen.
Great. This is a great app to use
Very convenient. I love ease and convenience of getting my favorite foods within 30 minutes at my doorstep.

Worst delivery service and customer service I experienced in my entire life. There is no customer rights with this application. After getting your money and confirming the order, they turn your food experience into a nightmare. Cant count the number of times I had an issue with my order and let go because they made it difficult to contact customer support, or even worse. You can make the effort to contact them but then end having no response or robotic answers with failure to understand the issue and unwillingness to solve it. Keep all this aside, my latest experience was really HORRIBLE and had me decide that I will not use this app ever again even if it was the only option. (Normally I only use it only when the restaurant I want is not on the other apps anyway ).
So I ordered from a restaurant and after my order got accepted and paid I got a call from the restaurant saying my main dish was not available and they offered to replace it with something else. I told them clearly NO. If you do not have my order please cancel the full order!! I also contacted liefernde on chat service and explained what happened. The response was we cannot cancel! The order is on the way and they ended that chat! I recieved food that was entirely different from what I ordered and they did not bother responding to my emails of complain! Can you imagine ordering something and getting something else without having the right to claim them wrong? I highly DO NOT RECOMMEND IT.

Frequently have orders cancelled after hours of waiting. More than half my orders are cancelled (usually about an hour AFTER they were supposed to be delivered), and the orders that are delivered are always late. Lieferando customer service is horrible.
Top App. It’s very reliable and they are taking good care of the customer. Always I order with confidence
Scam. This app is a scam. My order never arrived. When I called the restaurant the number was disconnected. When I call the app's customer service line that number was also disconnected.

don’t download!!! choose wolt instead. i rarely write reviews, but this app is just horrible. my order was cancelled just 5 minutes before the expected delivery time without any explanation (and i scheduled the delivery in advance). this was my first time ordering from lieferando. there was zero customer support about this, and in general. you can only write a form that barely gets you a reply, which takes forever. furthermore, the app is incredibly buggy. Awful. i never had those issues with wolt, and i highly advise you to opt for other courier / delivery apps.

Hidden costs and unclear menus. If you compare the costs of the dishes with the costs on the same restaurant’s website, you should not see a big difference but there is usually a quite large difference in price. I understand that is to help keep the app running but why should my cost of 4 pizzas go from 58 euros to 70? Sorry, but there is no reason for such a large profit margin. 

Also, it would be nice to click on a meal and see exactly what’s in it. No, there is only a warning for things like allergies. How am I supposed to know what I’m ordering from a foreign restaurant if there is no description?

Not worth my time to use the app when I can just go directly to the restaurants websites.

HORRIBLE. one of the worst food delivery services I’ve ever used. Ordered delivery through their website and went outside when the website notified that my food was delivered. Received no phone calls from anybody and when I went outside there was no food anywhere surrounding the building. Then called the store I ordered from and they sent out a new order. The second order did not arrive as well and did not receive a tracking number or anything. Then asked for a refund for the food I didn’t receive and was told that it was not possible because the food had been delivered and they had tried to call me multiple times. Then proceeded to show them proof of my phone log that showed no missed calls and was told this wasn’t enough proof to qualify for a refund. I double checked to see if I put the address and phone number in correctly and I had. Worst part is they can provide no proof of trying to call me or where the order was dropped off outside of my building. Truly one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had with a business and the utter lack of care I received as a repeat customer is very disappointing. Being blamed for their mistake as well is completely upsetting and I cannot believe I am expected to pay for a service I never received. Will never be ordering from them again and would recommend anybody who wants to order through this service to RUN AWAY.
Always logs me out. Every time I need to log back in and wait for that stupid code in my emails. Can you just finally fix that please?! You said this was fixed several app versions ago.

Terrible service. We have had multiple attempts to try to use this app with failed luck. We never get our order on time and the app never correctly shows where the driver is. If there were better options we wouldn’t ever use this service but unfortunately they all are about the same terrible service
Options. There aren’t enough options for where I live. And the process to get a refund is horrendously difficult.

Every few months I forget…. Every few months I forget how bad Lieferando is and I submit an order for a restaurant that is exclusive to them. Then sure enough I am reminded how bad it is with late deliveries, non-existent customer service, and poor communication to the customer.

‘Offline’ issue. Suddenly the app cannot be opened. It display that ‘you are off line’ but :first, I am not, second , check the setting of connection and network it looks unchanged and fine. Third, the app was good earlier last week. 
So what happened?
Can’t cancel order. Doesn’t give the option to cancel order

Horrible app. Terrible app. I wish I could give it 0 stars. The driver lied and told McDonald’s that he couldn’t find my location so he threw away my food. I ended up going to McDonald’s myself to get my food remade and the manager of the restaurant was just rude and nasty. He had a terrible attitude and didn’t want to remake my food. He called the cops & told me to leave the establishment. The driver eventually came and lied and said that he contacted my phone, which he never did because I didn’t receive any call. They didn’t cancel my order and they didn’t want to give me a refund. So I was left without food & a horrible experience with them. Terrible experience. Horrible management. Never again.
Refund.. The app said enjoy your meal but I never got my food. I waited almost 2 hours just for them to take my money and cancel my order.

Unreliable. I’ve ordered over a dozen times from this app and never had the order delivered anywhere near to the estimated time. It has on two occasions shown up 15 minutes early and in all others been 1-3 hours beyond the stated delivery time with no option to cancel delivery (a three hour delay is now overlapping with the next meal time). This evening, after waiting a full hour for the 35 minutes delivery window my order was cancelled with no explanation, just an email saying they will issue a full or partial refund in four days. I am so underwhelmed with this app and it’s inability to provide accurate information, I will no longer be using it.

Worst service. Liferando is by far the worst delivery service around. Terrible UX, worst selection of restaurants, slow delivery, almost nonexistent customer support. Definitely suggest you use a different app - even using nothing at all would be better.
:(. Put a translation button…
Annie + Family. We Love Delhi Grill!!

Last night. Last night I was called a racial slur. By my delivery driver. I wasn’t aware he was down stairs because as I kept track of the time on the delivery map, he arrived earlier then the map had showed. The map said he was 17 minutes away, so didn’t know he was downstairs until I received several calls from my hotel. As he walked away after giving me my food, he said a racial slur directed towards me.
Trashy ignoring customer service. Expect nuggets without a sauce, late like really long waiting delivery times. Berlin - Germany. Deleted the App!!
No customer service. I haven’t received 2 orders and no response from customer service at all.

funktioniert nur in deutschland. wenn man schon gezwungen wird eine funktionierende app (lieferheld) durch diese app zu ersetzten, wäre es auch super wenn die neue app in allen ländern (aka auch in österreich) funktionieren würde
What year is it. If DoorDash was designed in the early 2000s … this is what you’d would expect.
Deleted this junk app. Sick of getting cold food delivered so I uninstalled the app and will use other service.
Healthy food options. Wish there was more choices also wish there was better healthy options in Stuttgart.
Basically theft. Food never arrives, impossible to cancel/get refund

100% Scam. Do not use this app!. My experience was the same as the countless the other 1 star reviews. Food never got delivered, and the app offers no assistance. This company simply steals your money. Owners should be ashamed of themselves. Do NOT use this app.
Happy. Super amazing ,Thank you

Great app, until you need customer service. The app is great until either the restarant or driver doesnt bring your food. Good luck then when you try to recover your money. Lieferando doe NOT respond! Time for a billing dispute

Unfortunately… garbage. The app is ok, but the company is not customer centric whatsoever. If you have any issue, forget support. I had a delivery missing 4 items totaling over €20 and was told to contact Lieferando. Never a response and I lost my money, and a cold beer :( also, the “average delivery time” is completely wrong all the time. I’ve had orders say average time of 40 minutes and then get told 2 hours. The worst part is there is no way to cancel an order so you’re stuck waiting for food past the time you probably want to be asleep. I wish it was better, but unfortunately I’ve had bad experience after bad experience. They just need some simplified and standardized customer service policies to help us out a little. Let me cancel when there are issues, refund missing stuff quickly, and maybe give us a portal to message the restaurants.

Worst Delivery App. I ordered from 2 different restaurants and both times my food never arrived. The button on the app to call the restaurants is broken and doesn’t work, it’s been hours and I haven’t gotten any food. Don’t order with this

Horrible app. They don’t let you review their employees. No phone number to contact them if stuff goes missing. Half the time they don’t go back and bring you the food you ordered. Say I have points but my account says zero. Can’t leave reviews for restaurants. Don’t give refunds for stuff they didn’t give me including today. Had to order from a different restaurant and just pray they will actually deliver it because everybody relies on this dumb app out here. DoorDash is so much better and should be a model for this app.
Speed. Always late or not tracked
Was soll man sagen…. Tut alles was es soll, keine Mängel. Passt

Language barrier and possible area issues. I currently live in Niedermohr and a very frustrating thing is that your app advertises loads of places to order from but no matter what I only have 6 to choose from in this location apparently. Also I’ve switched your language on this app to English and it does change the titles of each food place to English but if you want to know what I’m ordering or what I’m adding to a meal it has not been changed to English making it very hard to order.
Awful. No real time customer service, account set to English but very little English, orders are constantly wrong…ugh…
Sehr gut. Ich hab diesem Essen sehr gut geschmeckt

SCAM. They did not send me what I wanted and when I emailed them to let them know he accused me of lying and said no I checked the order and you are wrong in which I returned and showed him a screenshot and proof of what I actually ordered and I do not recommend anyone to go here they are complete scam who will steal your money my customer support person was Kevin, Kevin should be fired

Stole my money. They never delivered my food and refused to refund me. Worst delivery service I’ve ever used. Avoid this app at all costs. I had to call my bank to charge back the purchases I never received.

Schlecht App, schlecht Lieferung. It is hard to begin, after using the app for sometime, how bad the app design and build is. If one can pass that, the delivery will often disappoint you and when this happens, the service staff offer almost no help and leaving customer hungry for hours. Please do better.

No Language Options. There should be an option to choose English on the app.

Edit: To clarify, you can choose English as a language, but it’s not very helpful. All of the menus are still in German. The language settings only impact the general tabs on the app, not the menus.

terrible. I moved to Germany recently and this app is not it at all. There’s no way of contacting a delivery person if they bring you the wrong things, or steal your food. And the most they’ll do is give you a €7 voucher even if your order was €30 or €40. Will be switching to UberEats instead.
It’s good but i waste money. Good Service. Good app. But expensive.

THE WORST FOOD DELIVERY APP EVER!!!. I order through this app for the very first time on Christmas evening. I was told the food would arrive in an hour to my location and was fine with the wait. However, the tracker never updated, and I never received my food. I called the owner of the establishment of where I ordered to ask the status of my food. He told that his deliverer arrived to my location but never left my food at the front desk of the hotel as I had requested. I was never called nor notified through the tracker which caused a huge inconvenience. While explaining to the owner that I paid for my food and my order should’ve been left there he hung up on my face. The disrespect of somebody to do that to a customer especially when they’re in the wrong and should fix the issue. I emailed the situation to Lieferando and the response I get was that the owner will not refund me the money therefore they can’t issue a refund to me. I never ever been in a situation where the customer is not satisfied and the restaurant nor customer service does their best to help the customer out. I paid and lost money on food that I never got due to unprofessionalism from both the owner of the establishment and food app customer service. Never again will I use this app as this is the worst food delivery app and will never recommend this to anybody. I would much rather walk and get my own food rather than use this app. This is just horrible, I would rather use Uber eats, or any other food delivery app as they understand the concept of professionalism.
